🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — the "Konfirmasi Dealer" pop-up (Hubungi Dealer / Keranjang) opens for a split second and the product is then added WITHOUT the customer confirming. Measured live: the pop-up has class is-active 300 ms after clicking KERANJANG, and by 700 ms the browser has already navigated to /checkout/cart/. dealer-select.js stops the click and the form submit with event.stopImmediatePropagation(), but Magento's own catalogAddToCart submit handler is bound to the same form EARLIER, so it has already started the AJAX add-to-cart before the dealer-confirm handler runs. The floating bar button also fires both a click on the source button and $form.trigger("submit").
❌ Problematic Code
// Kemana_PDPLayout/js/floating-addtocart.js
$button.on("click", function () {
  ... $sourceButton.trigger("click");
  ... $form.trigger("submit");        // reaches catalogAddToCart first
});
// Kemana_DealerList/js/dealer-select.js — bound after catalogAddToCart
$form.on("submit.dealerConfirm", function (event) {
  if (bypassDealerConfirm) { bypassDealerConfirm = false; return true; }
  return interceptDealerConfirm(event);   // too late: the add-to-cart request is already sent
});
✅ Fixed Code
// Run the dealer confirmation BEFORE Magento's add-to-cart: intercept in the capture
// phase (or bind catalogAddToCart only after confirmation) and let only the pop-up's
// "Keranjang" button submit the form.
form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
  if (bypassDealerConfirm) { bypassDealerConfirm = false; return; }
  if (!shouldShowDealerConfirm()) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation(); return; }
  event.preventDefault(); event.stopImmediatePropagation();
  checkDealerConflictThenConfirm();
}, true);   // capture phase — runs before jQuery handlers on the form

🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — CRITICAL (pricing). When a motorcycle is added to a cart that already holds a motorcycle from the SAME dealer, the replacement line is priced Rp. 0 and so are Subtotal and Jumlah Pesanan (still Rp. 0 after reloading the cart). Reproduced live 2026-10-14 in every same-dealer case: AEROX 155 → FAZZIO @ DETA BEKASI (TC 5.0), AEROX 155 → same AEROX 155 @ DETA BEKASI (TC 7.0), AEROX Silver Cyan → Metallic Red @ PUTERA RAGUNAN (TC 8.0). The PDP bar shows the correct dealer price right before the click (e.g. Rp. 30.700.000), and replacing across dealers (TC 6.0 / 9.0, via the "dealer lain" pop-up which clears the cart first) keeps the correct price. So the dealer price is lost only on the same-dealer "replace existing unit" path ("Satu pesanan hanya boleh berisi satu unit … digantikan").
❌ Problematic Code
Same-dealer add → server replaces the existing quote item (one-unit rule) → new item saved with
custom_price / dealer price = 0 → cart line Rp. 0, Subtotal Rp. 0, Jumlah Pesanan Rp. 0.
(Server code not inspected — SSH from the test machine is blocked; behaviour measured on the storefront.)
✅ Fixed Code
// In the add-to-cart / replace plugin: remove the old motorcycle item FIRST, then add the new one and
// apply the selected dealer's price to the NEW item (never copy price data from the removed item):
$quote->removeItem($existingItem->getId());
$newItem = $quote->addProduct($product, $buyRequest);
$newItem->setCustomPrice($dealerPrice)->setOriginalCustomPrice($dealerPrice)->getProduct()->setIsSuperMode(true);
$quote->collectTotals()->save();

Fix urgently — an order could be placed for Rp. 0. Check the same-dealer replace path of the one-unit rule (TC 5.0 / 7.0 / 8.0), and add a server-side guard that blocks checkout of a motorcycle line without a dealer price.

🔍 Element Inspector · <div> verify_text click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — CRITICAL (pricing). When a motorcycle is added to a cart that already holds a motorcycle from the SAME dealer, the replacement line is priced Rp. 0 and so are Subtotal and Jumlah Pesanan (still Rp. 0 after reloading the cart). Reproduced live 2026-10-14 in every same-dealer case: AEROX 155 → FAZZIO @ DETA BEKASI (TC 5.0), AEROX 155 → same AEROX 155 @ DETA BEKASI (TC 7.0), AEROX Silver Cyan → Metallic Red @ PUTERA RAGUNAN (TC 8.0). The PDP bar shows the correct dealer price right before the click (e.g. Rp. 30.700.000), and replacing across dealers (TC 6.0 / 9.0, via the "dealer lain" pop-up which clears the cart first) keeps the correct price. So the dealer price is lost only on the same-dealer "replace existing unit" path ("Satu pesanan hanya boleh berisi satu unit … digantikan").
❌ Problematic Code
Same-dealer add → server replaces the existing quote item (one-unit rule) → new item saved with
custom_price / dealer price = 0 → cart line Rp. 0, Subtotal Rp. 0, Jumlah Pesanan Rp. 0.
(Server code not inspected — SSH from the test machine is blocked; behaviour measured on the storefront.)
✅ Fixed Code
// In the add-to-cart / replace plugin: remove the old motorcycle item FIRST, then add the new one and
// apply the selected dealer's price to the NEW item (never copy price data from the removed item):
$quote->removeItem($existingItem->getId());
$newItem = $quote->addProduct($product, $buyRequest);
$newItem->setCustomPrice($dealerPrice)->setOriginalCustomPrice($dealerPrice)->getProduct()->setIsSuperMode(true);
$quote->collectTotals()->save();
📋 What To Do
Fix urgently — an order could be placed for Rp. 0. Check the same-dealer replace path of the one-unit rule (TC 5.0 / 7.0 / 8.0), and add a server-side guard that blocks checkout of a motorcycle line without a dealer price.

🖼️ Live Page Screenshot — the actual front-end element click to zoom
🔍 Element Inspector · <form> verify_visible click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — mandatory KTP fields that OCR could not read are NOT visibly highlighted. cart-document.js does flag them (adds mage-error to the field and creates #<field>-error with "Kolom ini wajib dilengkapi."), but the theme CSS hides that message (display: none) and the field border stays grey (rgb(163,163,163)), so the customer sees nothing. Measured live with a partly blurred KTP: Alamat empty → #cart-identity-address-error exists, display:none. Also, OCR writes label text into unreadable fields (Nama = "Tempat/Tgl Lahir", Pekerjaan = "Kewarganegaraan : Wni") instead of leaving them empty and highlighted.
❌ Problematic Code
<input id="cart-identity-address" class="input-text mage-error" required aria-invalid="true" value="">
<div id="cart-identity-address-error" class="mage-error" data-role="ktp-address-mismatch-error"
     data-error-kind="required" style="display:none">Kolom ini wajib dilengkapi.</div>
✅ Fixed Code
.cart-identity-document [data-role="ktp-form"] .mage-error[data-error-kind] { display: block; color: #e4002b; }
.cart-identity-document [data-role="ktp-form"] .input-text.mage-error,
.cart-identity-document [data-role="ktp-form"] select.mage-error { border-color: #e4002b; }

Show the required-field message and a red border for every mandatory field OCR could not fill (TC 21.0 / 22.0 / 31.0). In the OCR parser, discard values that are field labels ("Tempat/Tgl Lahir", "Kewarganegaraan …") so those fields stay empty and get highlighted.

⚠ Errorlocator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. Call log: [2m - waiting for locator('[data-role=\'ktp-form\']').first() to be visible[22m [2m 34 × locator resolved to hidden <form hidden="hidden" data-role="ktp-form" class="cart-identity-document__ktp-form">…</form>[22m
🖼️ Live Page Screenshot — the actual front-end element click to zoom
🔍 Element Inspector · <div> verify_visible click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — an unreadable KTP image does not lead to a form the customer can complete. The OCR endpoint answers {"success":false,"message":"The PaddleOCR service is not available right now."}; the widget then calls clearUploadState(), which removes the uploaded image and hides the whole KTP form, and shows that English message — which is also misleading (the service is up; it just could not read the image). TC 22.0 expects the mandatory fields to be highlighted so the customer can fill them in manually or replace the image.
❌ Problematic Code
// Kemana_OcrKtp/js/cart-document.js
.done(function (response) {
  if (response.success && response.data) { applyUploadResult(response.data); return; }
  clearUploadState();                                   // image + form discarded
  setMessage("error", response.message || ...);         // "The PaddleOCR service is not available right now."
})
✅ Fixed Code
.done(function (response) {
  if (response.success && response.data) { applyUploadResult(response.data); return; }
  if (response.data && response.data.document_image_url) {      // image stored, OCR found nothing
    applyUploadResult($.extend({}, response.data));               // keep image, show empty form
    setMessage("info", $.mage.__("Data KTP tidak dapat dibaca. Silakan lengkapi kolom yang wajib diisi atau unggah ulang foto KTP."));
    return;
  }
  ...
})
📋 What To Do
Return the stored image path even when OCR finds nothing, keep the KTP form open with every required field highlighted, and use an Indonesian message that tells the customer to complete the fields or upload a clearer photo. Reserve "service not available" for real service errors.
 FAIL

cityField.on("change", function () { clearAddressMismatchErrors(); loadDistricts(""); });

// Kemana_OcrKtp/js/guest-checkout-login.js
function requireLogin(config) {

}
✅ Fixed Code
function requireLogin(config) {
  if (isCustomerLoggedIn(config)) { return false; }
  showLoginRequiredMessage();          // with an Indonesian translation
  // remember the cart so the Yamaha ID login success handler redirects back to it
  $.cookie('yamahaid_login_referer', window.location.href, { path: '/' });
  authenticationPopup.showModal();
  return true;
}
// Yamaha ID login success (server side): redirect to the stored referer when it is a
// same-site URL, else to customer/account/.

🔍 Element Inspector · <table> verify_count click to zoom
🔍 Root Cause
[A] WEBSITE BUG — when a guest with a motorcycle in the cart logs in, the guest cart is MERGED into the customer's saved cart, so the cart then holds TWO motorcycles (e.g. NMAX from the account + FAZZIO from the guest cart) — and CHECKOUT still proceeds to /checkout/#shipping with both. This breaks the "one motorcycle (1 qty) per cart" rule (requirements row 58, TC 3.0-9.0). Magento's default quote merge (Quote::merge() on login) bypasses the replace-existing-motorcycle logic that runs on add-to-cart. BA remark on TC 54.0 / TC 7.0 reports the same symptom (quantity becomes 2 after login).
❌ Problematic Code
// Magento\Checkout\Model\Session::loadCustomerQuote() → $customerQuote->merge($guestQuote)
// — no plugin applies the one-motorcycle rule to the merged quote
✅ Fixed Code
// plugin: before/around Quote::merge — when the guest quote has a motorcycle, the guest's
// motorcycle (the most recent choice) replaces the one in the customer quote
public function beforeMerge(Quote $customerQuote, Quote $guestQuote) {
    if ($this->hasMotorcycle($guestQuote)) {
        foreach ($customerQuote->getAllVisibleItems() as $item) {
            if ($this->isMotorcycle($item)) { $customerQuote->removeItem($item->getId()); }
        }
    }
    return [$guestQuote];
}
📋 What To Do
Apply the one-motorcycle rule when carts are merged at login (keep the guest's latest motorcycle, quantity 1), and validate it again before checkout so a cart with two motorcycles can never reach /checkout/.
